only 3 validation windows: weight estimation is high variance
diagnosis.narrative: The series shows no clear long-run trend. There is little seasonal structure. Predictability is middling — structured signal and irregular noise are balanced. The series reads as stationary by the ADF/KPSS tests. A few outliers stand out (9 points, ~2% of the sample). Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau 0.236), which favours a robust combination.
